title: Three Months and One Short Bin
subtitle: 循环利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）
meta: 主题语境：循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）　|　核心词汇：limit　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 limit 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the warden ① set the limit that no family in the town would have recorded, and he said the setting was the whole of the month. The ② limit, meaning the bound itself and not the bin, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a limit, he said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ limit in that town had the same short bin beside it, and the ④ limit at the far yard, meaning the share they kept for the children to save and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A limit, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the warden said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the limit was the whole of the matter, meaning the rule and not the bound. The ⑥ limit, meaning the rule and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; limit, he said, is either something you set or the only word that means both a bound and a rule. He said the rule is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ limit had become a line in a notice, and the notice had become an argument about the short bin. The ⑧ limit of the whole thing, the warden wrote in April, was one town and three months of recording; limit, he said, is either the share at the far yard or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ limit I remember is the bound recorded in the notice, which closed in 2000 and is still recorded as the quietest in the town. A ⑩ limit, my mother said in 2002, is the only bound that improves by being recorded; every limit, she said, is a rule that has agreed to look like a bound. She said the rule was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 限度；限额（指镇子里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 限度；限额（指那个限额本身，与回收桶相对）
C. 固定搭配：set the limit 定下这个限额
D. n. 限度；限额（指留给孩子们省下的那一份那一个）
E. n. 节用之事（抽象总称，指一处镇子的限额之事）
F. n. 限度；限额（指告示里写到、被记载的的那一个）
G. n. 规矩、节制（指一件事里人人都省却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 节制（抽象总称，指人人都省却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: set the limit that no family in the town would have recorded

the limit at the far yard

answers.why: set the limit 意为“定下这个限额”，1993 年那位管理员把镇子里没有一位人家肯记载的一个限额做了一遍。
limit 意为“限度；限额”，指那个限额本身而不是回收桶，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
limit 意为“限度；限额”，指镇子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一只小小的回收桶。
limit 意为“限度；限额”，指最远那处院子角留给孩子们省下的那一份那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
limit 意为“规矩、节制”，指一件事里人人都省却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条规矩就是那件事的全部。
limit 意为“节制”，指人人都省却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个限额，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
limit 意为“限度；限额”，指告示里写到、被记载的的那一个，到 1998 年这一个成了告示里的一行。
limit 意为“节用之事”，管理员四月写道，整件事的限额之事是一处镇子和三个月份的记载。
limit 意为“限度；限额”，我记得的是告示里记载过的那一个，2000 年定下了，至今仍被说成镇子里最安静的一个。
limit 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，限额是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的限额。
